payload.leagueSummary: NET is a knife fight up top: KeithK75, Dan94, and CRANK are all living near the front, but the ways they get there are a mess of opposites. KeithK75 and Dan94 are straight-up ball-striking bullies who keep the floor high enough to survive, while CRANK is basically winning with a busted tee game, mediocre iron play, and a short game/putter combo that keeps bailing him out of the ditch. Below that, the window gets ugly fast: a few guys can flash scoring pop, but the pack is loaded with players bleeding shots in multiple categories and turning rounds into garbage fires.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 and Dan94 are the cleanest golf in the window: elite tee-to-green, low three-putt damage, and enough birdie production to make the rest of the field look like they’re swinging pool noodles.
CRANK is the weirdest contender in the bunch — the driver is a liability, but the short game and putting keep dragging him back from the edge like a drunk uncle at a wedding.

The bottom half is a crime scene: DREADFUL is doing enough damage everywhere to earn the name, IUDoc92 is leaking shots across the whole bag, and TEV_11’s approach play is absolutely torching whatever good intentions the rest of his game had.
